findings.location: Statement, final sentence: the Fortin bound is said to depend only on dimension and mesh shape regularity, not on mesh size.
findings.evidence: Step 2.2 obtains the Fortin bound from lem-na-scott-zhang-boundary-preserving-p1-interpolant, whose Statement allows constants to depend on the fixed domain D. The Fortin proof does not establish that this dependence can be removed. Prove a domain-independent interpolation bound or weaken the statement to allow dependence on D. The assigned Schur-bound consumer needs only a finite bound uniform in mesh size for fixed D, so its estimate remains supported.
